title: MZT Skopje claim Prva Liga title
description: MZT Skopje - Euro Nickel 89-78 MZT Skopje celebrated Prva Liga title. They edged Euro Nickel to sweep the championship series. The hosts trailed by 2 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 2-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 89-78. The best player for the winners was international point guard Andrej Magdevski (192-96) who scored 21 points and 6 rebounds. International power forward Bojan Krstevski (206-89, agency: BIG) chipped in 16 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists (on 6-of-7 shooting from the field). Four MZT Skopje players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was Croatian-Bosnian center Robert Rikic (219-90) who recorded a double-double by scoring 16 points, 12 rebounds and 6 blocks and point guard Jane Petrovski (181-87) added 15 points respectively.
